state_legend.active: The feature is the current task. At most one.
state_legend.blocked: Cannot continue until a documented blocker is resolved.
state_legend.passing: Required layers passed and evidence is recorded.

features.title: AGENTS.md is a router, not an encyclopedia
features.behavior: A fresh session reads one file and knows what the repo is, how to verify it, and where the detail lives.
verification: Confirm it names the verification command and links the topic docs.

layers.label: length
layers.repair: Keep AGENTS.md between 50 and 200 lines; move detail into docs/ and link it.

layers.label: links
layers.repair: Link docs/harness-design.md and state the verification command in AGENTS.md.

features.title: Persistent state files exist and are current
features.behavior: The next session can recover verified state and decisions from tracked files only.
verification: Open PROGRESS.md and confirm Current State, Next Steps, Blockers.
Open DECISIONS.md and confirm entries carry a reason.

layers.label: files
layers.cmd: test -f PROGRESS.md && test -f DECISIONS.md && test -f feature_list.json
layers.repair: Create PROGRESS.md, DECISIONS.md, and feature_list.json at the repo root.

layers.label: current-state
layers.cmd: grep -q '## Current State' PROGRESS.md && grep -q 'Last commit' PROGRESS.md
layers.repair: Add a Current State section to PROGRESS.md with the last commit and verification status.

features.title: Deterministic and consistency gates pass
features.behavior: make test and make check both exit 0 on a clean checkout.

layers.label: deterministic
layers.repair: Run make test and fix the failing reference or agent load before continuing.

layers.label: consistency
layers.repair: Run make check; fix the failing gate (arch, config, or MCP health).

features.title: Feature state is written only by the gate
features.behavior: A feature flips to passing only when its layers run and pass, with evidence attached.
verification: Run zara-cli verify H04 and confirm state and evidence change together.

layers.label: repair-output
layers.cmd: grep -q 'How to fix' scripts/zara_cli/commands/verify.py && grep -q 'evidence' scripts/zara_cli/features.py
layers.repair: Keep the gate printing a How to fix line and features.py recording evidence when layers pass.

layers.label: wip-rule
layers.repair: Keep at most one feature active; finish it before activating another.

features.title: Architecture rules are enforced by a command
features.behavior: Forbidden patterns and missing references fail the build with WHAT, WHY, FIX text.
verification: Introduce a forbidden pattern in a scratch file and confirm the gate fails.

layers.label: rules
layers.repair: Create .harness/arch-rules.json with at least one rule carrying what, why, and fix.

layers.label: runner
layers.repair: Fix the violation the arch gate reports, or the rule itself.

features.title: Startup and clock-out paths are executable
features.behavior: zara-cli init brings a fresh session to a verified baseline and zara-cli clean-check gates the exit.

layers.label: startup
layers.repair: Fix the failing environment check printed by zara-cli setup.

layers.label: clock-out
layers.cmd: uv run --project scripts --no-sync --quiet zara-cli session start && uv run --project scripts --no-sync --quiet zara-cli clean-check
layers.repair: Fix the clean-state check or the trace writer.

features.title: Harness2 improvement loop is dry-runnable
features.behavior: Propose-Probe-Compose runs without model calls in dry-run and records evidence in a ledger.
verification: Run the dry-run for both tasks.
Confirm the ledger path and adoption rule are documented.

layers.label: dry-run
layers.repair: Fix .harness/run_improvement.py so dry-run prints the plan and exits 0.

layers.label: ledger
layers.repair: Restore .harness/README.md and the candidates directory.

features.title: Memory MCP is healthy and documented
features.behavior: The Orchestrator server reports nine tools, FTS5, and a clean audit.

layers.label: health
layers.repair: Rebuild zmem-mcp from the submodule and point opencode.json at the binary.

layers.label: contract
layers.repair: Write docs/memory-contract.md covering the nine tools and the database path.

features.title: Repo config stays portable and plugin-free
features.behavior: The repo config loads on another machine without user-specific paths or a v1 plugin entry.
verification: Run opencode debug config inside the repo.

layers.label: portable
layers.cmd: uv run --project scripts --no-sync --quiet zara-cli config validate
layers.repair: Remove user-specific paths and fix broken references reported by the validator.

layers.label: no-plugin
layers.repair: Delete the plugin entry; V2 rejects the v1 plugin API.

features.title: Harness skill is discoverable
features.behavior: An agent can load a harness-engineering skill that names the repo gates.
verification: Open the skill and follow its checklist once.

layers.label: skill
layers.repair: Create the skill with valid frontmatter and the repo verification commands.

features.title: Session traces and quality snapshot exist
features.behavior: A session leaves a trace event and a quality snapshot the next session can read.
verification: Run make session-start and make session-end, then read the trace line.

layers.label: traces
layers.repair: Create .harness/traces with a .gitkeep and docs/quality-document.md.
